title: Achoris
summary: King listed in CFAH-11 Table 1 (Egypt Dynasties 19–20 and their CFAH alter egos (Dynasties 28–30)).
description: Ruler of Egypt Dynasties 19–20 and their CFAH alter egos (Dynasties 28–30). Person record added by the CFAH pass from the per-king rows of the OSF preprint CFAH-11 (Table 1, "Proposed Dynasty 20 Rulers and Reigns").

sorting_basis.note: Sorted by reign start (CFAH non-anchor dates). No tier 1–4 birth year. The year is the reign-start figure already printed on dates.reign: Rgn: 13; BC Dates: 392 - 379. Sort changed by the CFAH pass (2026-11-13): was none.

reign.citation: Griffith & White, "CFAH-11: Dynasties 20 and 21," OSF preprint v1.3 (17 Nov 2025), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/KSAZ9, file CFAH-11_v1.3.pdf, Table 1 "Proposed Dynasty 20 Rulers and Reigns", p. 22
reign.note: Row "Achoris/Hakor (D29)" of Table 1 (Egypt Dynasties 19–20 and their CFAH alter egos (Dynasties 28–30)).

reign.citation: Cory, Ancient Fragments (London: Reeves & Turner, 1876, ed. E. Richmond Hodges), p. 124; Manetho, ap. Syncellus, Chronicon 73 to 78, and Eusebius, Chronicle 16 and 17

dynasty: Egypt Dynasties 19–20 and their CFAH alter egos (Dynasties 28–30)
